_doc: Two cover keys held at once (NEXT, then HOME 40 ms later). Before 2026-11-02 the simulator kept one cover key at a time and the input service cleared its long-press state on any release, so HOME was lost and the position was not saved.

action.user.reader.next_page.why: exactly the one NEXT press (a lost release must not turn into a long-press repeat)

input.key_delivery_ms.count.why: NEXT and HOME, press and release each

storage.write_ms.count.why: HOME left the book: the reading position is saved

input.key_delivery_ms.max.why: HOME, pressed while NEXT is held, is reported at once: each cover key is its own touch point (with one point for all cover keys it waited for NEXT's release, ~41 ms; audit AUD-012)
